judgement.reason: Glance is a single Go web server that needs only a config file baked into the image, which is a contained change.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported storage: the image starts with the configuration file /app/config/glance.yml (ENTRYPOINT or CMD in Dockerfile), and no Dockerfile instruction creates that file. Deployz does not mount configuration files.
reviews.reason: The Dockerfile starts the app with /app/config/glance.yml, but it copies only the binary into the final image, so the configuration file must be supplied from outside the image, and nothing shown proves that it is optional.
